items.priorRationale: overlay 동작 유지, geometry만 비교
items.visualReview: partial 2026-10-07 IAB light 1280x720: page lists lamp, book and image variants. Opened lamp card; centered detail measured 500x658.6px. Other variants/dark/responsive pending.
items.interactionReview: Lamp example focuses first external link on open. Escape removes dialog; activeElement becomes BODY rather than the trigger. Did not follow external link.
items.adoptionDecision: Retain conditional recommendation for measured geometry only. Preserve HJM modal focus/priority/dismiss-complete lifecycle. Existing Native router shared-element adapter does not own local overlay transitions.
items.implementationBoundary: 2026-10-07: optional motionOrigin added to existing Web/Native Dialog with an experimental editing composition. Web retains one subtree until exit; Native guards stale/missing measurement and drops stale size geometry. Actual Web and iOS draft/failure/reopen flows checked; theme matrix, animation frames/performance, Android and promotion pending. See docs/qa/2026-10-07-overlay-origin-transition.md.

items.name: morphing-popover
items.priorRationale: overlay 동작 유지, geometry만 비교
items.visualReview: partial 2026-10-07 IAB light 1280x720: basic, custom-transition and textarea examples present. Inspected textarea variant; other variants/dark/responsive pending.
items.interactionReview: Add Note focuses textarea. After test draft and Escape, popover disappears and activeElement is BODY; reopening shows empty textarea. Submit was not invoked.
items.adoptionDecision: Absorb geometry into the existing Web Popover without copying source session ownership. motionOrigin uses shared Dialog presentation lifecycle and existing Popover placement, focus and dismissal. Product owns retained draft; Native uses Dialog/Sheet.
items.implementationBoundary: 2026-10-07: implemented Web Popover motionOrigin and three contextual editing variants within the existing origin-dialog experiment. Chromium regression covers final placement, resize while scaled, rapid reopen, outside-pointer focus and reduced-motion Escape. IAB verified failed save, retained draft after close/reopen, successful retry, light/dark and 390px large-text error layout. Full palette/RTL/frame-performance matrix and promotion remain pending; see docs/qa/2026-10-07-overlay-origin-transition.md.

items.visualReview: partial: 2026-10-07 IAB accessible after web fetch returned 403; rendered page has artwork basic/hover and directional slider examples. Do not treat web fetch failure as site-wide browser block.
items.interactionReview: partial: pointer over artwork reveals blur and author/title at opacity 1; no keyboard-focusable artwork control inside the preview. The direction demo is an automatic duplicated number strip, not input range. After CDP prefers-reduced-motion=reduce and reload, translateX changed from -1.8px to -1097px on consecutive observations; no pause control seen in the demo. Emulation restored. Dark/responsive/performance pending.
items.adoptionDecision: Use static artwork edge only behind always-visible copy, or a scroll-metric-driven hint. Do not inherit hover-only visual copy or automatic strip movement that ignores reduced motion. Implemented as an experiment; promotion remains pending.
items.implementationBoundary: 2026-10-07: contracts and both granular renderers implemented; scroll edges and focused content remove decoration. Native product blur/mask host keeps Expo dependencies out of published renderer. iOS 26.5 Expo Go actual composition, end-item selection, shrink-to-fit, dark tint correction and large-text initial screen checked. Android actual composition, accessibility, product palettes and performance remain pending. See docs/qa/2026-10-07-progressive-blur.md.
